# `/historical-identities` endpoints

Base URL: `https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com`

### GET /historical-identities/v1

`listHistoricalIdentitiesV1` — Lists all the identities — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

This gets the list of identities for the customer. This list end point does not support count=true request param. The total count of identities would never be returned even if the count param is specified in the request Requires authorization scope of 'idn:identity-history:read'

- Scopes: idn:identity-history:manage, idn:identity-history:read
- Parameters:
  - `starts-with-query` (query) — This param is used for starts-with search for first, last and display name of the identity
  - `is-deleted` (query) — Indicates if we want to only list down deleted identities or not.
  - `is-active` (query) — Indicates if we want to only list active or inactive identities.
  - `limit` (query) — max 250 — default 250 — Max number of results to return. See [API Standard Collection Parameters](https://developer.sailpoint.com/docs/api/standard-collection-parameters) for more information.
  - `offset` (query) — default 0 — Offset into the full result set. Usually specified with *limit* to paginate through the results. See [API Standard Collection…
- Returns 200: array of identitylistitem
